sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Compare these two examples. Find the step where they stop being the same.

items.prompt: A function contains the points (1, 5) and (3, 13). Write the function rule f(x) = mx + b.

steps: Use one point to find b: 5 = 4(1) + b, so b = 1.

items.prompt: A rental company charges a $30 base fee plus $15 per hour. Which function models the total cost f(x) for x hours?

steps: The base fee of $30 is charged even with 0 hours, so it is the initial value b.
The $15 per hour charge is the constant rate of change m.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Work these with your teaching parent. Say the reason for each step out loud before you write it.

items.prompt: A hiker climbs a steady, unchanging slope for the whole hike. Which description best matches the shape of the graph over time?
choices: increasing at a constant rate the whole time
decreasing at a constant rate the whole time

items.prompt:
A graph shows height over time.
From t = 0 to t = 2, height goes from 7 to 12.
From t = 2 to t = 3, height goes from 12 to 9.
From t = 3 to t = 4, height goes from 9 to 9.
Which interval shows the height increasing?
Consider the relation {(-4, -6), (-1, -4), (-8, 8), (-8, -7)}. Is this relation a function?
choices: Cannot be determined from the given pairs.
Yes, this relation is a function.
It is a function only if every output is different.
No, this relation is not a function.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Which set of ordered pairs does NOT represent a function?
Given f(x) = -6x - 22, find the value of x for which f(x) = -22.

Function B is given by f(x) = -2x - 13. Function A is given by the table:
x: 1, 3
y: 23, 47
Which function has the greater rate of change?
choices: They have the same rate of change.
Cannot be determined from the given information.

sections.title: Mastery check
sections.directions: Mastery check. Work without help, then stop and hand this section in.

items.prompt: Function B is given by f(x) = -5x - 10. Function A starts at 3 and increases by 8 each unit. Which function has the greater value when x = 10?
choices: Cannot be determined without a graph.
The two functions have equal values at that input.

items.prompt:
A table shows:
x: 2, 3, 4, 5
y: 23, 38, 59, 86
Is the relationship linear or nonlinear?
choices: cannot be determined from a table
